text: Bitcoin's modest 1% pullback contrasts with Ethereum's sharper 3.9% decline, suggesting profit-taking is hitting altcoins harder than the lead asset. The Fear & Greed index at 66 with a strong 7-day climb indicates growing confidence, though Bitcoin dominance holding at 59.3% and solid $123B volume show the market isn't panicking despite the dip. Smaller caps like SOL and BNB gaining while ETH lags hints at rotation into riskier bets within an otherwise risk-on sentiment.
